title: New municipal water connections
description: Prepare the application checklist from the municipal charter and direct the resident to their urban local body for submission.

title: Municipal water connection repairs
description: Identify documents requested for a repair and explain how to report the problem to the responsible municipality.

title: Property tax assessments and title changes
description: Distinguish a new tax assessment from a change of title and identify the corresponding municipal checklist.

title: Birth and death registration
description: Find the relevant registration procedure and checklist using the event and elapsed time. The civil registrar issues the certificate.

title: Municipal trade licences
description: Help business owners find the trade licence service for their urban local body and continue on the official portal.

title: Sewerage connections and charges
description: Find the sewerage or combined water and sewerage service for a municipality. Send applicants to the official payment and application channels.

title: MeeBhoomi land record navigation
description: Explain where to view land records or an electronic passbook. The resident performs the personal lookup on MeeBhoomi.

title: Public grievance intake and routing
description: Help a petitioner prepare a concise grievance and find the official route for lodging it. The receiving office provides the acknowledgement.

title: Soil and irrigation-water testing in Tirupati
description: Guide farmers to the district soil testing laboratory or Mandal Agriculture Officer for sample analysis and soil health card guidance.

title: Drip and sprinkler irrigation assistance
description: Explain the Nellore micro-irrigation registration route through the local Rythu Seva Kendra. Project officials process the application.

title: JnanaBhumi scholarship navigation
description: Help a student distinguish scholarship services and identify the college or portal step. Institutions verify individual applications.

title: Vaidya Seva hospital help desks
description: Explain the administrative role of a Vaidya Mithra help desk and route scheme or network-hospital questions to the official service.

title: Capital region planning services
description: Locate the capital region authority service for the requested certificate, plot enquiry or planning grievance.

title: MeeSeva income certificate guidance
description: Help residents identify the income certificate service and send them to the official application channel. Revenue officials verify and issue certificates.

title: Ration card corrections and printing
description: Identify the relevant MeeSeva civil supplies service for a household correction or card-related request.

title: Late birth registration guidance
description: Help residents distinguish late registration services and find the listed form applicable to their district.

title: Bhu Bharati land records and grievances
description: Use the Revenue Department FAQ to locate the process for a passbook, a record correction or a specific land grievance. Officials decide cases.

title: ePASS scholarship routing
description: Locate the official ePASS scholarship portal. Students complete registration and check their individual status with the service.

title: Outpatient appointment navigation
description: Route a patient to the listed outpatient registration service. Appointment availability and booking are determined by the hospital system.

department: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board
title: Hyderabad water bill assistance
description: Identify the official water bill service for Hyderabad residents. Customers view individual balances and pay through the board.

title: Electricity connections and load changes
description: Help a consumer distinguish new supply, load change and bill payment, then find the distribution company service.

title: BuildNow building and layout approvals
description: Route building and layout permission questions to BuildNow and its published support channels. The competent planning authority approves applications.

title: Pension service navigation
description: Locate the pension service and help the resident prepare questions for the welfare office. The department determines eligibility.

title: Contractor licensing for migrant workers
description: Locate the Labour Department service for contractor licensing related to migrant workers. Route employers to the official application.

title: Disability assessment and support directory
description: Identify the official SADAREM and disability support portals for assessment or service information.

title: Tour operator and accommodation registration
description: Direct a tourism business to the relevant listing for operator recognition or tourist accommodation registration.
